likelyCauses: One operation inside the batch violated a precondition even if earlier calls succeeded.
nextSteps: Use trace frame paths or per-call simulation results to identify the exact failing batch item.
title: Batched transaction inner call failed
summary: A batched or multicall transaction failed because one inner call reverted.

likelyCauses: The transaction was rejected by a wallet, bundler, relayer, paymaster, or simulation service before submission.
nextSteps: Inspect the preflight response, UserOperation validation data, paymaster response, and any nested revert bytes.
title: Transaction failed before reaching chain
summary: The transaction or UserOperation failed during client, bundler, or simulation preflight before an on-chain hash existed.

likelyCauses: The contract reverted with a custom error selector that requires ABI or selector lookup to interpret.
nextSteps: Decode the selector with the contract ABI or built-in selector catalog, then inspect the custom error arguments.
title: Opaque revert data needs decoding
summary: The error includes a selector or raw revert bytes but no human-readable reason.

likelyCauses: The failing contract used require(false), bare revert(), invalid opcode, or swallowed the lower-level revert data.
The top-level wrapper may have lost revert bytes from an inner call.
nextSteps: Use a trace/simulation payload to identify the failing internal call.
Check the called function's preconditions; gas changes rarely fix a logic revert with empty data.
title: Simulation reverted with no data
summary: The call reverted but did not return ABI-encoded revert data.
